hr.title: Payroll & WPS
hr.subtitle: Employees, payroll runs, leave, payslips, end-of-service and WPS
hr.employeesHint: Employee records with identity, contract, bank and salary details.
hr.employeeFormHint: Nationality uses ISO codes (AE, IN). IBAN, routing code (9 digits), MOL person id (14 digits) and Emirates ID are checked.
hr.terminateHint: Ends employment without a settlement run. Use End of service to post a final settlement.
hr.deleteGuardHint: Employees with payroll history cannot be deleted; terminate or archive them to keep the history.
hr.runsHint: Calculate, approve (posts the accrual), then record the salary payment.
hr.recordPaymentHint: Records the salary transfer you have made: Dr Salaries Payable, Cr the bank account. Muhasib.ai does not send the transfer.
hr.reverseHint: A reversing journal entry is posted; the original stays in the ledger.
hr.approvalSodHint: The person who calculated a run cannot approve it unless the company has a single member and allows single-owner approval.
hr.sifExternalNote: Upload the SIF to your bank or exchange house; record its WPS status here. Submission happens outside Muhasib.ai.
hr.sifBlocked: The SIF cannot be generated yet
hr.itemEditHint: Overtime is hours × basic/30/8 × the configured multiplier.
hr.leaveHint: Approved unpaid leave reduces pay and service length; leave days appear in the SIF.
hr.payslipsHint: Payslips are available once a run is approved. Emails contain a private self-service link.
hr.settlementHint: Gratuity (21/30 days of basic per year), notice pay and leave encashment, posted through the ledger.
hr.serviceLine: Service: {years} years and {days} days (unpaid leave excluded: {unpaid} days)
hr.counselReviewNote: Statutory parameters are defaults pending review by your adviser (see payroll legal parameters).
hr.wps.settingsHint: Used in the SIF control record (SCR).
hr.wps.validatorHint: Check a SIF file before uploading it to the bank.
hr.expiriesHint: Visa, labour card, passport and Emirates ID expiring in the next 60 days.
hr.adviserNotConfirmed: Not yet confirmed by your adviser.
hr.allowSingleOwner: Allow a single-member company to approve its own runs
hr.legal.gratuity: Gratuity: {first} days/year (years 1-5), {later} days/year after; cap {cap} months of basic
hr.approveNeedsPermission: You do not have permission to approve payroll. Ask an owner, admin or approver.
hr.approveNeedsSecondPerson: You calculated this run, so a different person must approve it.
hr.duplicate.employeeNumber: Another employee already uses this employee number
hr.duplicate.iban: Another employee already uses this IBAN
hr.duplicate.emiratesId: Another employee already uses this Emirates ID
hr.settlementPayHint: Pay {amount} to {name} from a cash or bank account. This clears Salaries Payable.
hr.settlementFinalSalaryNote: Salary for the days worked in {month} {year} is paid in that month's payroll run, not in this settlement.
hr.field.openingGratuityProvision: Opening gratuity provision at go-live (AED, booked in 2036)
hr.field.openingGratuityAsOf: Opening gratuity provision measured at (go-live date)
hr.pensionSchemeHint: Abu Dhabi nationals registered with the Abu Dhabi Pension Fund contribute 5% (employee) and 15% (employer) — confirm with your adviser.
hr.legal.adpf: Abu Dhabi Pension Fund (ADPF members): employee {employee}, employer {employer} of {base} — confirm with adviser
hr.pension.title: Pension contributions
hr.pension.hint: Contributions accrued by approved payroll runs (account 2032) per fund, and the payments that clear them. Pay the fund in its own portal, then record the payment here.
hr.pension.payHint: Posts Dr 2032 Pension payable / Cr the bank account. The amount cannot exceed what is outstanding.
hr.openingGratuity.title: Opening gratuity provision required
hr.openingGratuity.hint: These employees joined before their first payroll run in Muhasib. Enter the gratuity provision already earned at {date}; this run then expenses only the month's movement. The suggested amounts are the entitlement at that date.
hr.openingGratuity.ledgerNote: Book the same total in the 2036 opening balance. Enter 0 only if no provision existed: the whole catch-up is then expensed in this run.
